full_judgment: This Second Appeal is directed against a judgment of reversal. It is admitted by both sides that the plaint schedule properties belonged to the Mukherjees. One of them Narendra Nath Mukherjee, was owner of I/5th share of the lands, pacca building and pacca latrine of the suit premises. Narendra sold the same to Krishnapada Nath and his mother Shushila Sundari Debi who in their turn sold the same to the plaintiff Begun Azifa Khatun by a kabala dated 19.8.65. While the plaintiff claims that she has been living there with her family members enjoying the usufructs of the ejmali property such as tank, gar-den, etc. the defendants contend that the plaintiff's enjoyment is limited to the fenced off 1/5th portion of the suit premises.
